decisions.reason: As a flagship GIS platform closely aligned with the firm's core geospatial integration capabilities and supported by in-house R&D, it fits the firm's knowledge base well and is therefore likely to be retained and further developed.
Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's established enterprise geospatial offer, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and improve it, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.

The search extension builds directly on the firm's existing web map and search expertise and even showed version updates, so despite some product-line rationalization risk it is still more likely to be kept than dropped.
